query: A screening test has sensitivity 0.99 and false-positive rate 0.063. The prevalence of the condition is 0.024. Given a positive result, what is the probability that the person has the condition? Round to six decimals.
کوچک‌ترین عدد صحیح نامنفی x را پیدا کن که باقیماندهٔ تقسیم آن بر ۱۶ برابر ۱۳، بر ۹ برابر ۳ و بر ۵ برابر ۲ باشد.
A fair six-sided die is rolled repeatedly. What is the expected number of rolls until the consecutive pattern 2,3,3,2 first appears? Give the exact value.

یک گراف جهت‌دار وزن‌دار این یال‌ها را دارد (یال X->Y:w یعنی از X به Y با وزن w): A->D:۹, A->F:۴, B->F:۱۱, D->A:۷, D->F:۱, E->G:۱, F->D:۱۱, F->E:۱۴, G->A:۱۵, G->D:۴, G->F:۷. کوتاه‌ترین فاصله از A تا G چقدر است؟

Among 221 students, 111 take art, 89 take biology and 83 take chemistry; 50 take both art and biology, 44 take art and chemistry, 17 take biology and chemistry, and 12 take all three. How many students take exactly one of these subjects?
تعداد ۴تایی‌های مرتب از اعداد صحیح (x۱,...,x۴) که مجموعشان ۱۰ است و هر xi بین ۰ و ۸ (با خود این دو) است چند است؟
Using unlimited coins of values 5, 7, 9, 11, what is the minimum number of coins needed to make exactly 82?
تعداد مسیرهای شبکه‌ای از (۰,۰) تا (۹,۶) با گام‌های واحد به راست یا بالا که از نقطهٔ (۱,۵) عبور نمی‌کنند چند است؟

A bag contains 4 red, 6 blue and 6 green balls. 4 balls are drawn uniformly at random without replacement. What is the probability that exactly two colors appear among the drawn balls? Round to six decimals.
باقیماندهٔ تقسیم ۶۰۴^۹۲۵۳ بر ۲۹۹ چند است؟
Using unlimited coins of values 2, 3, 5, 7, in how many different ways (order does not matter) can you make exactly 44?
A fair six-sided die is rolled repeatedly. What is the expected number of rolls until the consecutive pattern 1,1,1 first appears? Give the exact value.

Boolean variables A,B,C,D,E satisfy all these clauses: (NOT E OR NOT B OR NOT C) AND (NOT B OR NOT D OR A) AND (NOT D OR NOT B OR NOT A) AND (E OR NOT C OR B) AND (NOT B OR E OR A) AND (NOT A OR NOT E OR NOT B) AND (B OR D OR C). Exactly 2 variables are true. How many satisfying assignments exist?

Boolean variables A,B,C,D,E satisfy all these clauses: (NOT A OR NOT E OR C) AND (B OR C OR E) AND (C OR NOT D OR NOT A) AND (NOT A OR E OR B) AND (NOT E OR NOT A OR NOT C) AND (E OR NOT A OR NOT D) AND (NOT B OR D OR E) AND (D OR C OR NOT B). Exactly 3 variables are true. How many satisfying assignments exist?

متغیرهای بولی A,B,C,D,E باید همهٔ این بندها را ارضا کنند: (NOT C OR B OR NOT D) AND (NOT A OR B OR C) AND (A OR NOT E OR NOT D) AND (NOT B OR C OR NOT A) AND (NOT B OR C OR D) AND (NOT C OR NOT E OR D) AND (NOT C OR D OR B) AND (NOT C OR NOT B OR E) AND (NOT B OR NOT D OR E). دقیقاً 2 متغیر درست باشد. تعداد انتساب‌های مجاز چند است؟ OR یعنی یا و NOT یعنی نقیض.

Each of A,B,C,D,E is either a knight (every statement true) or a knave (every statement false). A says: B and D have different types; B says: B and C have different types; C says: A and C have the same type; D says: A and D have the same type; E says: A and C have the same type. How many assignments of types satisfy all statements?

Each of A,B,C,D,E is either a knight (every statement true) or a knave (every statement false). A says: A and D have the same type; B says: A and D have different types; C says: C and D have different types; D says: C and E are both knights; E says: D and B are both knights. How many assignments of types satisfy all statements?

Each of A,B,C,D,E is either a knight (every statement true) or a knave (every statement false). A says: A and C include exactly one knight; B says: E and C have the same type; C says: D and A are both knaves; D says: D and B have the same type; E says: B and D include exactly one knight. How many assignments of types satisfy all statements?

Arrange A,B,C,D,E,F in a single row, each exactly once. Constraints: E before F; D before C; B before F; D before E; E before C; D before A; B and D must NOT be adjacent. How many arrangements are possible?

Arrange A,B,C,D,E,F in a single row, each exactly once. Constraints: D before C; E before D; E before F; C before A; B before D; C before F; D and A must NOT be adjacent. How many arrangements are possible?

Arrange A,B,C,D,E,F in a single row, each exactly once. Constraints: A before F; B before F; B before C; B before A; E before A; E before D; E and C must NOT be adjacent. How many arrangements are possible?
Assign four pairwise distinct integers A,B,C,D from {1,2,3,4,5}. Their sum is 13. A != 5, B != 1, C != 5, D != 5. Also |A-C| != 2. How many ordered assignments satisfy every condition?
Assign four pairwise distinct integers A,B,C,D from {1,2,3,4,5}. Their sum is 11. A != 2, B != 5, C != 4, D != 1. Also |A-C| != 1. How many ordered assignments satisfy every condition?
چهار عدد صحیح متمایز A,B,C,D را از مجموعه {1,2,3,4,5} انتخاب کن. مجموع آن‌ها 11 باشد. A != 4, B != 5, C != 2, D != 5. همچنین |A-C| != 2. تعداد انتساب‌های مرتب مجاز چند است؟
